conclusion: Not a misstatement: the terms establish the transfer point as physical delivery and signed customer acceptance under CON-C01-T1. CON-C01-T2 makes payment due 30 days after acceptance; no return rights, rebates, additional acceptance conditions, bill-and-hold, consignment, guarantee or related-party terms are stated in the supplied terms.

reasoning_chain.text: Term CON-C01-T1 states: "Control transfers only upon physical delivery and signed customer acceptance."

Revenue is recognised when the customer obtains control; where the performance obligation is not satisfied over time, the entity identifies the point in time of control transfer using the relevant control indicators.
Term CON-C01-T2 states: "Payment is due 30 days after acceptance."
The supplied terms do not state whether return rights, rebates, bill-and-hold, consignment, guarantees or related-party terms apply; no further terms on these matters are available to assess.

Control passes at a point in time, only after both physical delivery and signed customer acceptance, as specified in CON-C01-T1. The payment term is linked to acceptance but does not change that transfer event; no other relevant terms are identified in the supplied terms.

counter_argument: A further contract term stating that control, title or risk passes at a different event, or that an over-time criterion applies, would change the transfer-point conclusion.
